treatment_summary: Continue lisinopril 10 mg daily for hypertension (NG136 first‑line). Start high‑intensity atorvastatin 80 mg daily to address severe dyslipidaemia (CG181/CG126). Arrange baseline renal and liver function tests, calculate QRISK, and obtain exact BMI. If BMI ≥ 35 kg/m² and eGFR ≥ 30, consider adding metformin 500 mg daily after confirming safety. Provide lifestyle advice (salt restriction, DASH diet, 150 min/week exercise, weight‑management referral) and ensure safety planning for intimate‑partner violence. Monitor BP monthly until target, lipids at 3 months, renal function after ACE‑I/Metformin changes, and review all medications annually.
